final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS sf JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sf.zoneref WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.entrystat, step1.avg_traitcount, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count DESC LIMIT 10.
